name: Sofia Ramirez
bio:
Sofia's journey into motorsport began unconventionally, not on the track, but behind the scenes. After earning a degree in supply chain management, she initially worked in the automotive industry, streamlining production processes. A chance encounter with a local racing team needing logistical support ignited her passion for the fast-paced world of motorsports. She quickly adapted her skills, mastering the intricacies of transporting delicate equipment across continents, managing complex import/export regulations, and ensuring every component arrives precisely when and where it's needed.

Sofia approaches her role with meticulous precision and an unwavering commitment to efficiency. She thrives under pressure, calmly orchestrating logistical solutions even when unforeseen challenges arise. What sets her apart is her ability to anticipate potential problems, proactively mitigating risks to keep teams on schedule. Her reputation for reliability and resourcefulness has made her a sought-after logistics coordinator in the racing circuit.

Despite her ambition, Sofia is grounded by her loyalty to her teams. She believes in fostering a collaborative environment and providing unwavering support to her colleagues. Even though she prefers working independently, she always makes time to mentor those around her.

physical.hairStyle: Long, wavy hair usually tied in a practical ponytail.
physical.description: Sofia is of average height with a warm smile and a focused gaze.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with meticulously organized lists.
Insists on drinking yerba mate in the mornings before setting up for the day.
Has a lucky 'racing charm' keychain attached to her equipment bag – a miniature replica of a classic race car.
